ev.q: Among persons aged ≥18 years reporting COVID-19–compatible symptoms, 360,626 tests were included
rVE of a bivalent mRNA COVID-19 vaccine dose was 30% and 56% among persons aged 18–49 years
case-patients were persons who received a positive rapid or laboratory-based NAAT result
of these, 121,687 (34%) persons received positive test results
Absolute VE (95% CI), by no. of monovalent doses received before the bivalent vaccine dose
rVE increased with time since the most recent monovalent vaccine dose in all age groups
Multivariable logistic regression models were controlled for age, gender, race, ethnicity, SVI of the testing location
control-patients were those who received a negative NAAT result

methods_quotes.q: Absolute VE (aVE) was calculated by comparing the odds of receipt of a bivalent booster dose
rVE was calculated by comparing the odds of receiving a bivalent booster dose
Odds ratios (ORs) were calculated using multivariable logistic regression
VE was calculated as (1 − OR) x 100
Multivariable logistic regression models were controlled for age, gender, race, ethnicity, SVI of the testing location
